description: This Java source file defines the CommandSubscription class, which handles parsing and representing MQTT command subscription topics for IoT devices within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes logic for interpreting topic patterns, managing authentication details, and providing accessors for subscription properties.

classes.name: CommandSubscription
classes.description: Represents an MQTT subscription for device commands in the Hono framework, capable of parsing topics, managing device and tenant identification, and handling authentication context.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID extracted from the subscription topic or authentication data.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID extracted from the subscription topic or authentication data.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID from the authentication context, if available.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the MQTT QoS level associated with the subscription.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID of the MQTT connection.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the raw MQTT topic string.

methods.name: getRequestPart
methods.description: Returns the request part of the topic, typically 'req'.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Indicates whether the subscription was established with an authenticated device.

methods.name: isGatewaySubscriptionForSpecificDevice
methods.description: Determines if the subscription is for a gateway acting on behalf of a specific device.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription instance from a topic string and optional authenticated device context.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a CommandSubscription instance from an MqttTopicSubscription object and optional authenticated device context.
